title: The Ten Commandments
summary: The Ten Commandments follows a real Bible moment about obedience. God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others. When rules feel like a wall, this lesson shows that God's commands guide free people toward love and worship.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 20:1-17 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: God gave commands to teach His rescued people how to live with Him. God gave commandments to Israel after rescuing them. His law showed how His people should live with Him and one another. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others. The Ten Commandments also shows that obedience has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: God gave commands to teach His rescued people how to live with Him.
age_8_11_explanation: God gave commandments to Israel after rescuing them. His law showed how His people should live with Him and one another. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others.
The Ten Commandments shows obedience through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When rules feel like a wall, this lesson shows that God's commands guide free people toward love and worship.
life_application: When rules feel like a wall, this lesson shows that God's commands guide free people toward love and worship.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps The Ten Commandments connected to the actual passage?
choices: There were no words from God
quiz_questions.explanation: God is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: Which response best fits the lesson's point?
choices: Pretend the hard part in The Ten Commandments is not hard.
Use The Ten Commandments only to win a trivia point.
Ignore what God shows in The Ten Commandments.
When rules feel like a wall, this lesson shows that God's commands guide free people toward love and worship.
quiz_questions.answer: When rules feel like a wall, this lesson shows that God's commands guide free people toward love and worship.
quiz_questions.explanation: A useful Bible lesson changes how we see a real choice. God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others.

memory_verse.prompt: Practice Exodus 20:1 and listen for how it supports the lesson's obedience theme.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in The Ten Commandments?
What truth should a kid remember after reading The Ten Commandments?
How can the group pray about The Ten Commandments without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Commandment Road Signs
activity.instructions: Make road signs for loving God and loving people, then place them along a paper path.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use The Ten Commandments to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading The Ten Commandments.
